title: Official languages: Americas
intro: Pick an official language of each country in the Americas.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Grenada?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Grenada.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Honduras?
questions.explain: Spanish is an official language of Honduras.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)?
questions.explain: Spanish is an official language of Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of).

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Costa Rica?
questions.explain: Spanish is an official language of Costa Rica.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Bolivia (Plurinational State of)?
questions.explain: Quechua is an official language of Bolivia (Plurinational State of).

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Trinidad and Tobago?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Trinidad and Tobago.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Peru?
questions.explain: Quechua is an official language of Peru.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Barbados?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Barbados.
